title: 53 Swahili Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Swahili for Beginners (Love)
description:
Learn 53 essential Swahili phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Swahili #LearnSwahili #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in Kiswahili, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Swahili with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 53 real-life phrases
- Kiswahili audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Love · Upendo
1:29  Work & Office · Kazi na Ofisi
2:55  Friendship · Urafiki
4:14  Feelings & Emotions · Hisia na Machozi
5:28  Courage · Ujasiri
6:52  Purpose · Kusudi
7:58  Common Native Slang · Lugha ya Mitaani ya Kawaida
9:17  Celebrations & Parties · Sherehe na Mikutano

PHRASE LIST

LOVE · Upendo
• I choose you, every day. - Ninakuchagua kila siku,  [NinAKUchagua KIla Siku,]
• My heart smiles when you text. - Moyo wangu unacheka ukinitumia ujumbe,  [MOYO wangu unaCHEka uKinitumiA Ujumbe,]
• Thank you for loving me. - Asante kwa kunipenda,  [A SANte kwa kuNIPENda,]
• Stay close, I need you. - Kaa karibu, nawahitaji,  [Kaa kaRIBU, naWAHItaji,]
• You make ordinary days feel special. - Unafanya siku za kawaida zionekane za maana,  [uNafa yaa Siku za KA kawaida zionEkanE za MAana,]
• I’m proud to be your partner. - Ninajivunia kuwa mshirika wako,  [ninaJIVUNIA kuwa mshIRika WAko,]
• Let’s build something together. - Tuijenge kitu pamoja,  [TUijenge kiTu pamOja,]

WORK & OFFICE · Kazi na Ofisi
• I’m running late for my shift. - Nimechelewa kidogo kwa zamu yangu.  [nimeCHElewa KIdoGO kwa ZAmu yangu]
• Could you email me the invoice? - Unaweza kunitumia barua pepe ya bili?  [unaWEza kuNITumia baRUA pePE ya BIli]
• Please put this on my desk. - Tafadhali weka hii kwenye dawati langu.  [taFAadhali WEka HII kwenye DAwaTI lanGO]
• I need access to that folder. - Nahitaji ufikiaji wa folda hiyo.  [naHIta uFIKIaji wa FORda hiYO]
• The printer is jammed again. - Kichapishi kimekwama tena.  [kiCHAPishi kimeKWAMa TENa]
• Can we move the meeting to two? - Tuahirishie mkutano hadi saa mbili?  [tuAHIRISHie mkuTOno haDI saa mbili]
• I’ll be in the conference room. - Nitaelekea kwenye chumba cha mikutano.  [niTAelekea kwenye CHUMba cha MIkuTOno]

FRIENDSHIP · Urafiki
• Call me, I’m here for you. - Nipigie simu, niko hapa kwa ajili yako.  [NI-pi-gie SI-mu, NI-ko HA-pa kwa a-JI-i ya-ko.]
• We laugh together, that matters. - Tunacheka pamoja, hilo ni muhimu.  [TU-na-che-ka pa-mO-ja, HI-lo ni MU-him-bu.]
• You can count on me, anytime. - Unaweza kunitegemea, wakati wowote.  [U-na-we-za ku-NI-te-ge-me-a, WA-ki-ti WO-wo-te.]
• Let’s grab food after work. - Tukutane baada ya kazi, tuende kula kitu.  [TU-ku-ta-ne BAa-da ya KA-zi, TU-en-de ku-la KI-tu.]
• Your support means a lot to me. - Uungwaji wako unani-manufaa sana.  [U-un-gWA-ji wa-ko u-na-ni-ma-nu-faa SA-na.]
• I trust you with my secrets. - Nakutegemea, naweza kukwambia siri zangu.  [NA-ku-te-ge-me-a, NA-we-za ku-KWAm-bia SI-ri zan-gu.]

FEELINGS & EMOTIONS · Hisia na Machozi
• I feel light, like relief. - Nina hisia nyepesi, kama unafuu.  [Nina hi-SIA NYE-pe-si, KA-ma u-NA-fuu.]
• I’m proud of myself right now. - Ninajivunia mwenyewe sasa.  [Na-ni-JIVu-ni-a MWE-Nyewe SA-sa.]
• That made me laugh out loud. - Hilo lilinichekesha hadi nacheka kwa sauti.  [HI-lo li-li-ni-CHE-kE-sha ha-di na-CHE-ka kwa SAu-ti.]
• I’m nervous before the meeting. - Naogopa kidogo kabla ya mkutano.  [Na-O-go-pa ki-di-go ka-BLA ya MU-ku-ta-no.]
• My chest feels tight, I’m worried. - Kifua changu kinabana, na wasiwasi.  [KI-fua cha-ngu ki-na-BA-na, na wa-SI-wai-si.]
• I miss you so much today. - Leo nakukosa sana.  [LE-o na-Ku-KO-sa sa-na.]

COURAGE · Ujasiri
• I can do this, even now. - Naweza kufanya hili, hata sasa.  [NAweza fanya hiLI, hata SAza.]
• I’ll speak up, no matter what. - Nitaongea wazi, bila kujali chochote.  [NItaONgea waZI, biLA juLI choCHOte.]
• Step in, don’t freeze. - Sogeza mbele, usigande.  [SOgeza MBELE, uSIgande.]
• I’m not backing down today. - Sitajitoa leo, kwa njia yoyote.  [SItajitoA leO, kwa JIlya yoYote.]
• Call them, I’ll follow. - Piga simu, mimi nitaenda pia.  [PIga SImu, MIE niTAenda pia.]
• I’ll try once more, calmly. - Nitajaribu tena, kwa utulivu.  [NItaJAriBu TENa, kwa uTULivu.]
• This fear won’t drive me. - Hofu hii haitaniendesha.  [HOfu hii haiTAnienDEsha.]

PURPOSE · Kusudi
• My purpose today is simple - Kusudi langu leo ni rahisi  [Ku-SU-di la-ngu LE-o ni RA-hi-si]
• I need a clear purpose - Nahitaji kusudi lililo wazi  [Na-hi-taji ku-SU-di li-li-o WA-zi]
• I’m doing this with intention - Nafanya hivi kwa nia  [Na-na-fa-a hi-vi kwa NII-a]
• Tell me your real goal - Niambie lengo lako halisi  [Nii-aM-bie LEN-go la-ko ha-LI-si]
• What’s the point of this? - Kusudi la hii ni nini?  [Ku-SU-di la HII ni NII-ni]
